version.changelog: 步0和步5加粗警示+具体路径: 步0改为搜_working/全部清单(含同名和其他), 步5改为任务完成后强制搜其他清单; 新增2条陷阱

llm.summary: This Obsidian organizer is instruction-only and mostly purpose-aligned, but it gives the agent broad authority to edit/delete notes and automatically use web searches or remote images, so users should review it carefully before installing.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent with Obsidian note organization, but the workflow includes broad vault-wide search, creation, modification, deletion, and automatic relationship generation across many notes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill uses mandatory, non-skippable instructions for note processing and relation creation; only the separate `kg 检查` path clearly asks before execution, while normal organization commands appear to proceed directly.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec, code files, dependencies, credentials, or static-scan findings were provided; the risk comes from the instructions the agent would follow, not hidden executable code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill targets a hardcoded Obsidian vault path and instructs file search/read/write/delete plus web search and image embedding, while registry metadata declares no required config paths or capability tags.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No credential or privileged account access is shown, but the skill stores task checklists in `_working/` and resumes unfinished work in later sessions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, decide whether you are comfortable letting the agent reorganize and edit your Obsidian vault. Back up the vault, require confirmation before deletions or batch changes, review `_working/` checklists, and disable or approve web/image searches case by case for private notes.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to perform broad local file operations, including creating relationship notes, modifying existing notes, and deleting content/files as part of normal workflow. The artifacts do not show clear per-change approval for the normal `kg` commands.
evidence.snippet: 读写拆分即关联：新建/拆分/读到/修改任何主体笔记时，立即触发 R0（搜关联→建关系）。 ... 任务预期产生 ≥5 个文件操作（新建/修改/删除）时，必须先建清单再动手。 ... 已有更完整→删

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Install only if you want this level of automatic vault editing. Keep backups and require explicit user confirmation before batch edits, deletions, or relationship creation.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent could make many changes to an Obsidian vault, including deleting or rewriting note content, based on its own classification and search results.

evidence.explanation: The skill tells the agent to use external search/image providers and embed remote image URLs based on note content. For private notes, even note-derived queries or remote image loads can disclose sensitive topics to third parties.
evidence.snippet: `kg 完善` ... 搜索网络补充更新 ... 同步图片嵌入（主动，不可跳过） ... 搜索来源：百度图片 / Google Images / Wikipedia

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Ask the agent before any web search or remote image insertion, and avoid enabling this behavior for private or sensitive vaults.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note topics may be sent to search engines or exposed through remote image requests when notes are viewed.

evidence.explanation: The skill attempts to make itself the mandatory workflow for Obsidian-related tasks. This is aligned with its purpose, but users should notice that it may steer the agent automatically whenever matching note tasks occur.
evidence.snippet: 打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill。 ... 其他 agent 执行命令前必须先 `kg start` ... 路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Enable it only for vaults where this workflow is desired, and explicitly tell the agent when a task should be read-only or should not use the KG method.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may apply this KG workflow even when the user only intended a small or read-only note task.

evidence.explanation: The skill persists task state in local checklist files and later uses those files to resume work. This is disclosed and useful, but altered checklist files could influence future edits.
evidence.snippet: 中途中止 → 清单文件保留，下次会话恢复 ... read_file 完成检查清单 → 从未完成步开始续接

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review `_working/` checklist files before resuming tasks, and delete outdated checklists when they should no longer control future work.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A stale or manually changed checklist could cause the agent to continue unintended file operations in a later session.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The main concern is broad, mandatory local file mutation across the Obsidian vault without consistently clear approval boundaries.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account privileges, or delegated third-party account access are shown in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill can use note-derived information in external web/image searches and stores resumable task state in local checklist files.
